notes.title: Ver1.02 Patch Notes
notes.content:
​[h2]Improvements[/h2]​​
[list]
[*]Increased the spawn rate of rare items
[*]Items that have reached the maximum carry limit will no longer appear in shops
[*]Locked items will no longer reappear when refreshing the shop
[*]Increased enemy health and damage in Endless Mode
[/list]

​​[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]​​
[list]
[*]Fixed bomb damage not scaling with floor progression
[*]Fixed some achievements not triggering in Endless Mode
[/list]

notes.title: Ver0.103 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Entering non-combat areas now increases corresponding stats.
[*]Improved the description of primary stats.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed camera movement stuttering during fast travel.
[*]Fixed untranslated text in the outfit customization interface.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update Notes Ver0.102
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Added random pitch variations to weapon sound effects.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Fixed incorrect audio issues with kunai and boomerang.
[*] Resolved camp voice lines malfunction.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.101 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Maximum frame rate capped at 60 FPS (may not apply on high-refresh-rate displays due to VSync).
[*]Optimized audio implementation and added some missing sound effects.
[*]Increased font size in certain UI elements for better compatibility with Steam Deck.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed incorrect background music switching when returning to the main menu during gameplay.
[*]Fixed an issue where protective weapons were not hidden when the player was attacked by monsters.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver0.100 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Content Adjustments[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Repulsion Orb's function has been adjusted to fire additional energy balls upon hitting a target.
[*]Dash now has a 1-second internal cooldown.
[/olist]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*]Fixed an issue where some weapons' inherent effects would disappear after attacking.
[*]Fixed an issue where the font color became hard to read when the Faith Gauge was full.
[*]Fixed an issue where the damage bonus from "Frenzied Monsters" was calculated incorrectly.
[/olist]

notes.title: Survivor Girls of Monster Dungeon ON Sale ！
notes.content:
After two years of development, Monster Dungeon Survivor Girl is now online!

Welcome to experience it!



Butter and pudding are delicious. When the developer logo appears when entering the game (when nakukinoko appears): press N+K (keyboard) at the same time to unlock the sweet fruit ！

notes.title: Demo Version Updated
notes.content:
1 New weapons have been added.
